{"entry":"launch-checklist","command":"/launch-checklist","problem":"Claude Code Game Studios is one project template (867 files: 78 skills that call its own scripts, docs and hooks), so a per-skill Gene would break 75 of them and the whole template exceeds the 256-file skill limit. Every Gene here pins one 2-file installer skill that fetches the template at a pinned commit, checks its git tree id and only adds missing files; entry Genes differ in what they are recalled for and which studio command they hand over to.","argument_hint":"[launch-date or 'dry-run']","description":"Launch readiness across every department: code, content, store, marketing, community, infrastructure, legal, go/no-go sign-offs. Start it only when the user types /launch-checklist; never begin it on your own.","user_only":true,"sections":["Phase 1: Parse Arguments","Phase 2: Gather Project Context","Phase 3: Scan Codebase Health","Phase 4: Generate the Launch Checklist","1. Code Readiness","2. Content Readiness","3. Quality Assurance","4. Store and Distribution","5. Infrastructure","6. Community and Marketing","7. Operations","Go / No-Go Decision"],"handover":"5. Hand over the command that matches the request, to run in the new session:
   - make or change a game: `/prototype <idea>`
   - new user, no idea or engine yet: `/start`
   - wants game ideas: `/brainstorm <genre or open>`
   - existing project to bring in: `/prototype --from <path>` for a browser game, `/adopt` for
     design docs and stories
   - launch readiness: `/launch-checklist` (it starts only when the user types it)

strategy: 先按前置条件安装 skill ccgs-studio-setup 并通读；项目根目录已有 project.yaml 和 .zcode/skills/launch-checklist/ 时说明已装过，跳过安装。
运行 sh .agents/skills/ccgs-studio-setup/install.sh <folder>：新游戏用新的空目录，已有项目用它的根目录；脚本按固定 commit 取模板、核对 tree id、只补缺失文件，不覆盖任何已有文件，被保留的文件逐个告诉用户。
请用户以该目录为根重开 ZCode：工作室的 agent、skill 和 hooks 只在会话开始时加载，本会话里还不存在。
在新会话里请用户亲自输入 /launch-checklist [上线日期或 dry-run]：这个命令只由用户启动，不要自行开始。
summary: CCGS 入口 /launch-checklist：先用 ccgs-studio-setup 把 Claude Code Game Studios（ZCode 版 v1.3.0，MIT）整套装进项目，重开 ZCode 后运行 /launch-checklist；正文记下该命令的说明、参数和章节目录、钉住的安装 skill 与模板 commit。（此 Gene 在前置条件中钉住 skill ccgs-studio-setup，使用前先安装并阅读它。）
code_snippet:
test -f project.yaml && test -d .zcode/skills/launch-checklist || sh .agents/skills/ccgs-studio-setup/install.sh .
test -f .zcode/hooks/yaml-helper.sh && echo installed
# restart ZCode with this folder as the root, then in the new session:
/launch-checklist [launch-date or 'dry-run']
